parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main enclosure that houses the internal components and washing chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, contains the washing compartment, and ensures water-tight operation during cleaning cycles.
parts.Movement_description: The body itself is stationary and does not move during operation, though it supports moving internal racks and the door.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: The base of the dishwasher is made of galvanized steel and serves as the foundation of the appliance.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the dishwasher, houses the motor, pump, and drainage components, and provides stability during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The base remains fixed and does not move, but it supports internal moving parts such as the pump and rotating spray arms.
